subject: the 38.5MB game blob (f3) — fully decrypted via a 7-level recursive container chain

trigger_discovery.problem: the f3/e2 blobs are registered raw (flags 0x102) with no consumer doing an id-0xf3 lookup
trigger_discovery.solution: e3's init (entry[7]=+0x23d8, called by the stage-2 orchestrator) calls +0x2330 which does raw_scan(module_id + 0x10, registry) — for e3 (id 0xe3) that is device 0xf3, the raw blob registered by the PREVIOUS entry in the same orchestrator loop. +0x23c0 is a stack-switching trampoline (sub x6,x6,#0x40; mov sp,x6; mov x30,x6; b +0x2084) into e3's private second-level container orchestrator. The orchestrator's id range check (id <= 0xe2) is not an error path — out-of-range ids (0xe3) first wipe that device id (anti-reentrancy) then proceed.
trigger_discovery.same_pattern: e4 (+0x2428 lookup, +0x24b8 trampoline -> +0x20e4 orchestrator), e5, e6, e7, e8 — one processor module per level

second_level_container_format.head: 8 bytes {w0, w1} at blob start; entries table at +8, 0x5C bytes each (23 dwords), terminated by the first entry that fails to process (the real loop exits when the dd70 decrypt of a misread entry fails)
second_level_container_format.seed: ((id*0x9D323CD7) << (id&0xB)) + ((id*0x9D323CD7) >> (id&7)) mod 2^32, where id = the CALLING processor's device id (0xe3 for level 2, 0xe4 for level 3, ...)
second_level_container_format.countword: deob(w0 + w1) ^ (seed + 0xF119421B); head_g = seed + 0x5590AD79 + countword (stored at e3+0x1a314)
second_level_container_format.magic_unused: deob(w0 + 0xCBF0C1D8) ^ (seed + 0x4178CB33) is computed then wiped — never validated
second_level_container_format.entry_decode: per dword j of 23: dec[j] = (0x79934CF6 + j*0xE64D33D8) + head_g + (deob(raw[j] ^ (prev_raw^2 >> 3)) ^ eshift) - (m2 >> ((4j+3)&5)) where prev_raw chains across dwords (0xF02F7685 seeds the chain), eshift = ((head_g+0x96F60B71)*head_g) << ((index+1)&3), m2 = head_g*0x06A55BCC + (head_g+0x96F60B71)*head_g
second_level_container_format.fields: {id, flags, src_off, src_size(=image size, stored bytes are LZ-smaller), dst_off, dst_size, f6, init_fn, fnptr2, ...}
second_level_container_format.chained_square_note: the entry transform squares the PREVIOUS raw dword inside the loop (mul w0,w0,w0 at loop head with w0 = raw[j-1] from the previous iteration) — missing this makes every decode fail

processor_module_format.trailer: {0xF4, 0x00000000, 0x000E0100} then a 240-byte private AES-256 schedule at trailer+0xC, then the stream key dword at trailer+0xC+0xF0+0xC
processor_module_format.pipeline: dd70 modules: seed = sq(stream_key) with the STANDARD stage-2 dd70 head/tree/pair formulas; chunks = stream(stream_key) -> CBC(private schedule) -> tree-LZ scatter (identical to stage-2 semantics, private keys)

protector_chain: same 7 levels, same module ids/sizes for the shared prefix; keys: e3=0x6c74, e4=0x2c54, e5=0x3cb9, e6=0x5d1f, e7=0x1c96, e8=0x5ce8; the game-specific 0x9d/0x9e are small (0x87f0/0x5e8) — the protector carries only the shell
game_engine_content: module 0x9e (L4_m9e_image.bin, 10.2MB): [0,0x300000) tables/data, [0x300000,0x400000) dense ARM64 code (1024/1024 insns), [0x400000+) the C++ symbol/string pool — cocos2d-x, masterdb, leveldb, CRIWare (criAtom/CriMana), bisqueApp UI, Quest/KizunaBattle/PiratesArena/SugoFes game classes with full mangled names
remaining_encrypted: 0x9d (31.7MB, level-6 raw): no static processor consumes it (id+0x10 => 0x8d, absent) — decrypted at runtime by the game code (device registered, looked up by decrypted modules)
0xf8 was consumed by e8; nothing else remains
